name: Baby Unicorn
description: If this card would be sacrificed, destroyed or returned to your hand, return it to the Nursery instead.

name: Baby Unicorn
description: If this card would be sacrificed, destroyed or returned to your hand, return it to the Nursery instead.

name: Horse With An Ice Cream Cone
description: Ice cream always saves the day.

name: Innocent Bunnicorn
description: Look, Mom! I'm a unicorn!.

name: Adorable Flying Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, each player (including you) must SACRIFICE a card. If this card is sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand.

name: Angel Unicorn
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may SACRIFICE this card, then bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable.

name: Cotton Candy Llamacorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, each player (including you) must SACRIFICE a Unicorn card, then DRAW a card.

name: Extremely Destructive Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, each player (including you) must SACRIFICE a Unicorn card.

name: Extremely Fertile Unicorn
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD a card, then bring a Baby Unicorn card from the Nursery into your Stable.

name: Frenchiecorn
description: When this card enters your STABLE, each other player must DISCARD a card. Choose one fo the discarded cards and add it to your hand.

name: Glitter Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may bring an Upgrade card from your hand into your Stable.

name: Llamacorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, each player must DISCARD a card.

name: Magical Kittencorn
description: This card cannot be destroyed by Magic cards.

name: The Tiniest Unicorn
description: This card cannot be destroyed by effects of Unicorn or Upgrade cards.

name: Unicorn Of Death
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may SACRIFICE a Unicorn card, then DESTROY a Unicorn card.

name: Unicorn Of Famine
description: Each player's hand limit (including yours) is reduced by 5 cards.

name: Unicorn Of Pestilence
description: When this card enters your Stable, DISCARD any number of cards. Each other player must DISCARD the same number of cards.

name: Unicorn Of War
description: When this card enters your Stable, each player (including you) may DESTROY a Unicorn card. This card cannot be destroyed.

name: Unicorn Phoenix
description: If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, you may DISCARD a card instead.

name: Unicorn Rainbow Princess
description: When this card enters your Stable, choose any number of players. DRAW cards equal to the number of chosen players. Each chosen player may DRAW a card.

name: Zombie Unicorn
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD a Unicorn card, then bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable. If you do immediately end your turn.

name: A Cute Attack
description: Choose another player. DESTROY 3 Unicorn cards in that player's Stable and bring 3 Baby Unicorn cards from the Nursery into that player's Stable.

name: Fire And Brimstone
description: SACRIFICE all of your Unicorn cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card in each other player's Stable. Search the deck for a Unicorn Phoenix card and bring it into your Stable, then Shuffle the deck.

name: Unicorns Of The Apocalypse
description: SACRIFICE 4 Unicorn cards, then search the deck for 4 Unicorn cards and bring them into your Stable. Shuffle the deck.

name: Heavenly Smite
description: SACRIFICE all of your Unicorn cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card in each other player's Stable. Search the deck for an Angel Unicorn card and bring it into your Stable, then Shuffle the deck.

name: Llamapocalypse
description: SACRIFICE all of your Unicorn cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card in each other player's Stable, Search the deck for a Llamacorn card and  bring it into your Stable, then Shuffle the deck.

name: Overpopulation
description: SACRIFICE all of your Unicorn cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card in each other player's Stable. Search the deck for an Extremely Fertile Unicorn and bring it into your Stable, then Shuffle the deck.

name: Plague Of Death
description: SACRIFICE any number of cards, then DESTROY the same number of cards.

name: Spray Bottle Of Youth
description: DESTROY a Unicorn card in each other player's Stable. Each other player may bring a Baby Unicorn from the Nursery into their Stable.

name: Storm Of Cuteness
description: SACRIFICE all of your Unicorn cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card in each other player's Stable, then Shuffle the deck.

name: Ultimate Destruction
description: SACRIFICE all of your Unicorn cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card in each other player's Stable. Search the deck for an Extremely Destructive Unicorn card and bring it into your Stable, then Shuffle the deck

name: Unicorn Nap
description: Force another player to skip their next turn.

name: Zombie Apocalypse
description: SACRIFICE all of your Unicorn cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card in each other player's Stable. Search the deck for a Zombie Unicorn card and bring it into your Stable, then Shuffle the deck.

name: Neigh
description: Play this card when another player tries to play a card. Stop their card from being played and send it to the discard pile. Both you and that player may DRAW card.

name: Rainbow Sprinkles
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DRAW 3 cards. If you do, immediately end your turn.

name: Special Delivery
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may bring a Baby Unicorn card from the Nursery into your Stable. If you do, skip your Action phase.

name: Tiny Hooves
description: Your hand limit is reduced by 4 cards.
